# Flitch Coffee

> Specialty coffee shop in a remodeled 1952 Spartan trailer in East Austin, Texas. Outdoor, covered, dog-friendly and kid-friendly patio; open every day 7am–3pm. Opened in 2015.

- Address: 641 Tillery St, Suite 110, Austin, TX 78702 (corner of Holton & Tillery; shares a lot with Harvest Lumber Company)
- Phone: (512) 698-1326 · Email: manager@flitchcoffee.com
- Hours: Monday–Sunday, 7:00am–3:00pm
- Ratings: 4.7/5 from 475 Google reviews; 4.6/5 from 134 Yelp reviews
- Known for: Little Sweetie (cold brew, maple syrup + milk), maple latte, cortado, golden milk, Pueblo Viejo breakfast tacos
- Coffee and partners: Onyx Coffee (house cold brew), Creature Coffee (house drip), Proud Mary, Zhi Tea, Sour Duck pastries, Andy K's Donuts (weekends)
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/flitchcoffee/
